title: A Birthday Celebration for Jennifer & Philip

arrival.label: Friday, May 1 at 12:57 PM
arrival.via: SBH via Tradewind 172 from San Juan

departure.label: Wednesday, May 6 at 11:20 AM
departure.via: SBH via Tradewind 123 to San Juan

summary.highlights: Beach club lunches, a full day at sea, the Bagatelle White Party, and five unforgettable dinners

body: Jennifer and Philip, you are going to have the best time!
I can't think of anywhere more fun to celebrate a momentous birthday, and hopefully the first of many trips back!

Fouquet's is one of my favorites, especially for your first stay. The hillside setting, the views, the in-town location, such a good home base! A hotel rep will meet you at SBH on arrival, and from there, all you have to do is enjoy it.

The week is all lined up: beach club lunches at La Guérite, Nao, and Gypsea, dinners at the hot spots (including Bagatelle's iconic White Party), and a full day on the water on your private Axopar. And we have your Moke lined up and ready to go as well!
Your reservations and boat day are confirmed and ready to go. The concierge there is lovely and will help you with any additional planning or questions you might have.
And of course, if anything comes up while you're away, I'm always just a text or email away. Bonus points if you want to send me a bunch of pictures and make me incredibly jealous.
Wishing you the most wonderful trip!

days.title: Arrival in St. Barths
days.subtitle: Travel day · welcome dinner in Gustavia

items.title: JetBlue 1803 · JFK to San Juan
items.body: Depart John F. Kennedy International at 6:30 AM EDT. Arrive Luis Muñoz Marín International (SJU) at 10:19 AM AST.

items.title: Tradewind 172 · San Juan to St. Barths
items.body: Tradewind Aviation flight TJ 172 from SJU to Gustaf III Airport (SBH). Arrive 12:57 PM AST. With VIP Experience, a member of the Tradewind team will meet you at your arriving gate and escort you through the airport to the Tradewind private lounge. If you have checked luggage, the team will retrieve and check it in for you.
items.meta: Booking Reference: TJRDBU · Class: M · Luggage limit: 50 lb / 23 kg per person

items.title: Touchdown in Saint Barthélemy
items.body: A Fouquet's representative will be waiting for you at the airport to escort you to the hotel.

items.title: Check-in at Fouquet's Saint-Barth
items.body: Settle into your Prestige Suite Pool Sea View. Take the rest of the afternoon at the pool, in the suite, or wandering the property.
items.meta: Address: Dit Lurin, Lieu, Saint Barthélemy · Hotel: +590 590 297 900

items.title: Dinner at BONITO St. Barth
items.body: Your welcome dinner at one of Gustavia's most beloved restaurants. Modern Latin American cuisine, sweeping harbor views, and a buzzy, candlelit room. The table is held for two hours.
items.meta: Address: 6 Rue Lubin Brin, Gustavia · Phone: +590 590 27 96 96 · Confirmation: 9P2AYT3PJPHH

days.title: Beach Club Saturday & Bagatelle White Party
days.subtitle: A long lunch on the sand · the island's most iconic Saturday night

items.title: A leisurely start
items.body: Breakfast at Fouquet's, in the dining room or served in your suite. Afterward, the pool, your private terrace, or a stroll on the property.

items.title: Your Moke arrives
items.body: Your Moke rental will be dropped off at the hotel this morning, ready for you to pop down to Gustavia, the beaches, or anywhere on the island for the next four days. The concierge will hand over the keys.

items.title: Sunbeds at La Guérite Beach
items.body: Your Fouquet's loungers are available from 10:30 AM. Settle in for a sun-soaked morning before lunch.

items.title: Lunch at La Guérite Beach
items.body: Mediterranean menu, Greek-inspired flavors, perfect rosé, and the kind of beach lunch that easily turns into the whole afternoon.

items.title: Bagatelle White Party
items.body: The night St. Barths is most famous for. Your table is confirmed outside for the legendary Saturday White Party. Lively, glamorous, exactly the kind of night you tell stories about for years.
items.meta: Minimum spend: €350 per person on wine and champagne · Dress code is all white.

days.title: Nao Beach & Le Beef Bar at Home
days.subtitle: A barefoot Sunday with a quiet dinner steps from your suite

items.title: Slow morning at the suite
items.body: Breakfast in or out, the pool, or, if you are feeling adventurous, the concierge can arrange a paddleboard or short hike before the day warms up. Ask the concierge to call Nao first thing to request sunbeds for the afternoon.

items.title: Lunch at Nao Beach Club
items.body: Sundays at Nao are one of the island's most legendary beach parties. The vibe builds from a chic, leisurely lunch into a full-blown Sunday afternoon scene, with the resident DJ taking the energy from chill to electric as the day goes on. Lively, glamorous, and exactly the kind of barefoot Caribbean Sunday you came for. The concierge will reach out in the morning to request sunbeds, though they cannot be guaranteed in advance.

items.title: Dinner at Le Beef Bar
items.body: Tonight's dinner is just steps from your suite at Fouquet's own Le Beef Bar. A perfect, lower-key Sunday after a sunny afternoon. World-class beef, an elegant room, and the easiest walk home of the week.

days.title: A Day At Sea Aboard the Axopar
days.subtitle: Your private boat charter · the highlight of the week

items.title: Boarding at the Ferry Dock
items.body: Drive your Moke down to Gustavia. The Fouquet's concierge will give you directions to find Jicky Marine. Boarding is at the Ferry Dock facing the Pharmacy on Rue de la République, where the Jicky dispatcher will meet you and walk you to the boat.

items.title: Full Day Charter · Axopar 37
items.body: Your private Axopar 37 with crew for the full day. Picnic on board is included. Plan for snorkeling stops, a swim at Colombier or Île Fourchue, and lunch at anchor in a quiet cove.
items.meta: Operator: Jicky Marine St. Barth · Confirmation: AXOPAR 37 · Email: info@jickymarine.com · Hotel concierge: concierge-stbarth@fouquets.com

items.title: Sella · 1001 Nights
items.body: Tonight is Sella's legendary 1001 Nights party. Chef Assaf Granit's Mediterranean and Jerusalem-inspired tasting menu paired with one of the most electric rooms on the island. Dinner transforms into a full nightlife moment as the resident DJ takes over and the room dances late into the night. A perfect, glamorous way to cap off your day at sea.

days.title: Gypsea & Isola
days.subtitle: Your last full day · spent exactly the way it should be

items.title: Reserve sunbeds at Gypsea
items.body: Ask the concierge to call Gypsea first thing to lock in your sunbeds for the afternoon. The hotel handles this for you.

items.title: Lunch at Gypsea Beach Club
items.body: One of the newer, more design-forward additions to the island scene. A long, glamorous lunch right on Saint-Jean Bay with that signature aerial view of the Tradewind planes coming in.

items.title: Farewell dinner at Isola
items.body: Coastal Italian, beautifully done. The pasta is exceptional, the room is intimate, and it is the perfect last-night dinner.

days.title: Departure Home
days.subtitle: A morning swim, one last breakfast, and back to New York

items.title: Moke pickup
items.body: The rental company will collect the Moke from the hotel this morning. Leave the keys with the concierge before you head to the airport.

items.title: Hotel transfer to SBH
items.body: The concierge will reconfirm the exact pickup timing 24 hours prior, but plan for around 10:00 AM. Settle any incidentals on the folio before you go.

items.title: Tradewind 123 · St. Barths to San Juan
items.body: Arrive SJU at 12:25 PM AST.

items.title: JetBlue 2602 · San Juan to Westchester
items.body: Arrive HPN at 9:00 PM EDT. Welcome home!

lodging.description: A historic address tucked into the hillside above Lurin, with sweeping views of the Caribbean and the harbor. Reimagined by Gilles & Boissier and reopened as one of the island's most beautifully designed properties, Fouquet's offers an elegant colonial feel with a fresh, intimate sensibility.
